name: VS Code Server
description: Run VS Code in the browser, allowing you to code and run development environments directly on your cloud instance.

fields.label: VS Code Password
fields.help: Required. Set the password you will use to log into your VS Code development environment.

compose_template:
version: '3.8'

services:
  code-server:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/code-server:latest
    container_name: selfhost-code-server
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - DEFAULT_WORKSPACE=/config/workspace
      - PASSWORD={{PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/config:/config
      - {{APP_DATA_DIR}}/config/custom-cont-init.d:/custom-cont-init.d
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  default:
    name: selfhost-network
    external: true
